library.template_body:
# Subject

Brief description.

## Current situation

Verified state, verification date and source links.

## Open actions

Action, owner, known due date and source. Keep one authoritative action.

## Decisions in force

Decision, reason and source.

## Useful documents

Procedures and references.

## History

Links to replaced decisions and earlier states.
library.evidence: Mechanical checks only. Editorial proposals require source-by-source review; hashes do not establish truth. Original source paths and bodies are retained. No vault files have been changed by preparation.
library.next: Review preview and changes.diff; run library check against the live vault. Apply only through apply_organization_manifest (validate, then apply the same bundle/token), with other writers stopped and a verified backup. Verify receipts, reread notes and verify incoming links afterwards.

errors.duplicate_note_identity: Inspect the conflicting note IDs; choose their identities explicitly, then retry indexing.
errors.StaleChunkError: Read the parent note and refresh the index before requesting a new chunk ID.
errors.search_index_stale: Retry the same read: it refreshes the changed notes first. On a read-only server, run `datacron index` before retrying.
errors.search_query_too_large: Shorten the query to the few distinctive words that matter; use search_regex for an exact passage.
errors.WriteConflictError: Read the current target and original request receipt; reprepare only uncommitted work.
errors.recovery_required: Stop writers and inspect recovery. Preserve the operation journal and pending files.
errors.manifest_already_committed_state_diverge: This manifest is already committed and the vault changed since; nothing is corrupt and no recovery is needed. Do not replay it: plan a new manifest from the current vault state.
errors.context_budget_too_small: Retry with required_tokens or read _memory/INIT.md. Reuse a known contract hash only when its instructions remain in context.
errors.committed_index_incomplete: The note is already committed. Repair indexing and reread it; do not create a new write request.
errors.internal_error: Use the correlation_id to locate the local diagnostic. Inspect the original receipt before retrying a write.
errors.follow_up_offset_invalid: Restart at offset 0, or continue with the next_offset and snapshot_hash returned by the previous page.
errors.follow_up_validation_failed: Correct the record as the message states, rereading the target and source notes for fresh hashes and an exact excerpt, then prepare again. Nothing was written.
errors.follow_up_sensitive_content: The field named in the message holds secret-shaped text. Quote an excerpt and write a summary, owner and identity basis that leave the secret value out, then prepare again. Nothing was written.
errors.follow_up_record_count_exceeded: Split the records into several calls of at most {max_records} each and apply each call's plans before preparing the next. Nothing was written.
errors.heading_ambiguous: Several sections match the selector named in the error. Use get_note format=map to inspect the headings, then pass the level for inter-level matches, or the level, the occurrence and expected_hash for same-level duplicates.
errors.frontmatter_edit_refused: Nothing was written. The frontmatter key named in the error cannot be changed without rewriting keys the request did not touch. Read the note with get_note, edit that key by hand (for example remove its YAML anchor or alias), then retry with the new content_hash.
errors.section_has_subsections: Nothing was written. Patch one of the listed subsections with its level and occurrence, or remove it explicitly with delete_note_section first, then patch the section again with the new expected_hash.
errors.section_structure_changed: Nothing was written. Close every code fence, HTML comment or raw HTML block the new content opens, or repair the note's existing structure after reading it with get_note, then retry with the current expected_hash.

health.index_stale: After resolving identity and recovery blockers, reconcile or rebuild the index, then verify health.
health.identity_mismatch: Run ops inspect-id and review each authority before selecting an explicit repair.
health.writes_disabled: Check read-only mode, configured write paths and durability policy before enabling writes.
health.integrity_review: Read full health findings and resolve the reported integrity or scrubber anomalies before maintenance.

help.vault_root: Vault root. Fallback: DATACRON_VAULT_ROOT, then cwd containing VAULT.yaml under .datacron.
help.memory_vault: Dedicated memory vault root (.datacron/ and _memory/ live here). Fallback: DATACRON_MEMORY_ROOT.
help.dual_vault: Prompt interactively for a dedicated memory vault path during setup.
help.keep_source: Keep the original .datacron/ and _memory/ in the documentation vault (default). Pass --cleanup-source to remove them once the copy is verified.
help.migrate_client: MCP client to reconfigure for the new memory vault ({choices}). Default: all detected clients; 'none' leaves every client unchanged.
help.migrate_enable_write: Enable or remove the write allowlist in the reconfigured clients. Omitted, the current write setting of each client entry is kept.
help.reset_invalid: Allow the write to replace an invalid or unreadable file with defaults plus the given values. Without it, an invalid file is refused, never reset.
help.migrate_cleanup_only: Copy nothing: verify the source _memory/ against the memory vault (or the copy manifest) of an earlier migration, then remove the source .datacron/ and _memory/. Cannot be combined with --keep-source/--cleanup-source, --client, --scope or --enable-write/--no-write.
help.single_vault: Return a Dual-Vault install to Single-Vault: the client entry drops DATACRON_MEMORY_ROOT instead of keeping it.

setup.memory_vault_explain_1: Dual-Vault mode separates your documentation vault from Datacron's sidecar (.datacron/) and agent memory (_memory/).
setup.memory_vault_explain_2: Default: disabled (empty), which keeps everything inside the main vault.
setup.memory_vault_explain_3: Enter a directory path to store .datacron/ and _memory/ in a dedicated memory vault.
setup.memory_vault_prompt: Memory vault path (leave empty for single-vault)
setup.memory_vault_kept: Kept the dedicated memory vault {path} named by the existing client entry. Pass --single-vault to return to Single-Vault.

migrate_memory.hash_mismatch: SHA-256 verification failed after copying {rel_path}; source files were preserved.

inbox.diff_empty: This change left the text identical.
inbox.diff_unavailable: The exact text of this change is no longer stored, so no diff can be shown.
inbox.diff_redacted_change_only: Only content hidden by redaction changed; nothing else differs.

inbox.revert_conflict: The note changed since this list was loaded. Reload the inbox and look at the change again before reverting.

errors.migration_paths_required: Both vault_path and memory_vault_path are required for migration.
errors.cleanup_needs_confirmation: Removing the source requires an explicit confirmation; nothing was migrated.
errors.cleanup_needs_clients: Removing the source requires reconfiguring the MCP clients in the same run; otherwise they keep pointing at the removed memory. Nothing was migrated.
errors.migration_os_error: The migration stopped on a file system error: {detail}. The source vault was not cleaned. Close every Datacron server and MCP client using it, check the paths and permissions, then run the migration again: files already copied are verified and kept.
errors.index_missing: Index database not found; run Synchronize Index first.
errors.payload_too_large: Request payload exceeds maximum allowed size.
errors.invalid_content_length: Content-Length must be a non-negative integer.
errors.invalid_json: The request body is not valid UTF-8 JSON.
errors.body_not_object: JSON request body must be an object.
errors.busy: Another vault operation is running; retry when it has finished.
errors.inbox_invalid_since: since must be one of: 24h, 7d, 30d, all.
errors.inbox_not_found: No such change in this vault's journal.
errors.inbox_state_conflict: The review state changed since it was read; the list has been reloaded.
errors.inbox_lock_busy: Another Datacron writer holds the vault lock. Nothing was changed; retry shortly.
errors.inbox_writes_disabled: Writes are disabled for this vault, so nothing was reverted.
errors.inbox_expected_hash_required: expected_hash must be the current SHA-256 of the note.
errors.inbox_revert_conflict: The note changed since you loaded it, so nothing was reverted. Reload the inbox.
errors.inbox_revert_creation: A creation cannot be reverted: there is no earlier text to restore.
errors.inbox_history_unavailable: The earlier text of this change is no longer stored, so it cannot be restored.
errors.inbox_note_missing: The note no longer exists at this path.
errors.inbox_revert_noop: The note already has that earlier text.

error.symlink: Refusing to migrate symlink or reparse point: {path}
error.lock_busy: Another Datacron writer holds the source vault lock: {vault}. Stop the Datacron servers using it, then retry.
error.pending_operations: The source vault {vault} has {count} pending write operation(s); nothing was migrated. Start the Datacron server once on this vault to finish them, or inspect them with `datacron ops inspect`, then retry.
error.cleanup_blocked: Source cleanup refused: {path} could not be moved ({detail}). Nothing was deleted and the copy in the memory vault is complete and verified. Close every Datacron server and client using the documentation vault, then run the source cleanup again (Companion: Remove the migrated source; command line: the cleanup-only option of migrate-memory).
error.cleanup_rollback_incomplete: Source cleanup refused: {path} could not be moved ({detail}), and these moves could not be undone (original <- current location): {stranded}. Nothing was deleted; move these entries back by hand.
error.cleanup_without_copy: No completed migration was found in {memory_vault}; run the full migration before a cleanup-only run.
error.cleanup_source_differs: The source was not removed: {count} source file(s) are not in the memory vault as copied: {paths}. Copy or merge them into the memory vault first, or run the full migration again while the memory vault is unchanged.

warning.tombstone_left: The source was moved out of the documentation vault, but {path} could not be deleted ({detail}); delete it by hand.
warning.cleanup_skipped_client_errors: The source was kept because an MCP client could not be reconfigured; fix the client configuration, then run the source cleanup (Companion: Remove the migrated source; command line: the cleanup-only option of migrate-memory).
